parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch lever of a wall switch, made of durable ABS plastic. It is the movable part that users press or flip to control electrical flow.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the actuator that toggles the electrical circuit between on and off states.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rocks around a hinge or axis when pressed, returning to its original position after actuation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting plate of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate plastic. It provides structural support and houses the internal electrical components.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the fixed support structure that holds the switch mechanism and attaches to the wall or electrical box.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
